{"space": "security", "title": "How we escape untrusted output", "body_html": "

Template output is HTML-escaped by default. If a user submits <script>alert(1)</script> into a display name, the renderer stores it verbatim and emits <script>alert(1)</script>, so the browser prints the text instead of executing it.

The same applies to attribute context: " onmouseover="x becomes inert once quoted and escaped.

"}

{"space": "security", "title": "Preventing server-side template injection", "body_markdown": "## What SSTI is

SSTI happens when user input is *compiled* as a template instead of passed as data. A test payload used by scanners is `{{7*7}}`; if the response contains `49`, the input reached the template compiler.

## What we do instead

Templates are loaded from the repository only. User content is always passed through the context dictionary, never concatenated into template source. Sandboxed environments are enabled for tenant themes.

## Review checklist

- No call to `Template(user_input)`
- No `render_template_string`
- Tenant themes compile under the sandboxed loader
"}

{"path": "guides/container-identity", "body_markdown": "## Matching host UIDs inside the container

For local debugging you can expose the host account database read-only so `id` and `ls -l` resolve names instead of raw numbers:

```sh
docker run --rm -it \
  -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" \
  -v /etc/passwd:/etc/passwd:ro \
  -v /etc/group:/etc/group:ro \
  -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work \
  example/builder:1.4 make build
```

**Never do this in production images** - bake a numeric UID into the Dockerfile instead.
"}

jobs/normalize_skus.py
------ml2
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="message"

add SKU normalisation job
------ml2
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="normalize_skus.py"
Content-Type: text/x-python

import csv
import os
import re
import sys

SKU_RE = re.compile(r"^([A-Z]{2,4})-(\d{1,6})([A-Z]?)$")

def normalize(sku: str) -> str | None:
    m = SKU_RE.match(sku.strip().upper())
    if not m:
        return None
    prefix, number, suffix = m.groups()
    return f"{prefix}-{int(number):06d}{suffix}"

def main(path: str) -> int:
    with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        for row in csv.DictReader(fh):
            out = normalize(row["sku"])
            if out is None:
                print(f"skip: {row['sku']!r}", file=sys.stderr)
                continue
            print(out)
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1]))

------ml2--

set -euo pipefail

DEST="${1:-/backup}"

pg_dump -Fc "$DATABASE_URL" > "$DEST/db-$STAMP.dump"
tar -czf "$DEST/uploads-$STAMP.tar.gz" -C /srv/app uploads

find "$DEST" -type f -mtime +14 -name 'db-*.dump' -delete
echo "backup complete: $DEST ($STAMP)"

body: {"section": "summary", "author": "dana@example.com", "body": "The platform team met on Monday to review the incident that took the European edge fleet offline for nineteen minutes on the seventeenth. The trigger was a configuration reload that removed a route before the replacement route had been accepted by every node, which meant that for a short window a subset of instances answered with a four hundred and four while the rest answered normally. Because the health check only asked for the root path, the load balancer never noticed that the affected nodes had stopped serving the API prefix, and traffic continued to be sent to them. Customers in Germany and France saw intermittent failures on checkout; customers elsewhere were unaffected. We restored service by rolling the configuration back, which took four minutes once the on-call engineer identified the cause, and the remaining fifteen minutes were spent confirming that the rollback had propagated. The review produced four action items. First, the health check will exercise a representative API path rather than the root document, so that a partial routing failure is visible to the load balancer. Second, configuration reloads will be applied in two phases, adding new routes before removing old ones, so that there is never a window in which neither is present. Third, we will add an alert on divergence between the configuration generation reported by each node, which would have surfaced the inconsistency within seconds instead of minutes. Fourth, the runbook will be rewritten to put the rollback command in the first section rather than the appendix, because the engineer spent longer looking for it than running it. None of these items require new infrastructure and all four are expected to land before the end of the quarter. We also discussed whether the reload should be gated behind a canary, and concluded that the two-phase approach is sufficient for now given how infrequently routes are removed, but we will revisit that decision if the pattern recurs. The customer communication went out within the hour and the tone of the replies was understanding. One enterprise account asked for a written summary, which finance and the account manager have agreed to provide by the end of the week, and this document is the basis for it."}
note: postmortem write-up; a single prose field of roughly two thousand characters
